unit.name: cpu_pkg
unit.behaviour: Declares alu_op_t, then includes one file per class in dependency order (base class first, CPU last because it uses both derived classes).

spec_text.FR-011: Represent ALU operation codes using an enum type.
spec_text.FR-012: Create a cpu_pkg package that holds all CPU definitions.
spec_text.IF-014: cpu_pkg.Operation code set: 4-bit operation codes / enum
spec_text.D-001: Declare typedef enum logic [3:0] {...} alu_op_t; once in cpu_pkg, with the 14 listed codes (OP_SEL_B=4'b0000 ... OP_ROR=4'b1101). Both alu_op and Calc's operation use alu_op_t.
spec_text.D-013: extern is not used (it is optional). Methods are defined inside each class.
spec_text.D-014: cpu_pkg defines alu_op_t and includes base_alu.svh, logical_alu.svh, arithmetic_alu.svh, cpu.svh in that order. Each class stays in its own file.

coding_rules.tags: every line implementing an ID ends with // @ID
coding_rules.only_tag: IDs in owns or uses of this slice
